title: Views & Tag Helpers
description: Master Razor views, layouts, partial views, view components, and tag helpers — the tools that turn server-side C# into clean, maintainable HTML.
longDescription: This module teaches the view layer of ASP.NET Core MVC. You will start with Razor views and layouts, then learn how partial views and view components reduce duplication and add server-side power. From there you will discover how built-in tag helpers automate form generation, link creation, and asset management, before writing your own custom tag helpers to encapsulate reusable HTML transformations.
whatYouLearn: Create and structure Razor views with layouts and sections
Understand how ASP.NET Core resolves view files
Use partial views and view components for reusable UI
Inject services directly into views with @inject
Use built-in tag helpers for forms, links, inputs, and caching
Write custom tag helpers to transform HTML with C#
